title: Host Terms of Service: One Host Account per Customer
content:
# Host Terms of Service — Holding a Host Account

**Clause 1 (single account).** A customer may hold only one host account with Roamhaven's Host Accounts: the limit is 1 host account per customer. Every listing, co-host seat and payout method of the customer hangs from that one account.

**Clause 2 (second account).** A second host account requested by a customer who already has a host account in any status other than deactivated is not opened.

**Clause 3 (after a suspension).** A customer whose host account was deactivated by Roamhaven after a suspension may not open a new one.

**Clause 4 (businesses).** A business is one customer, with its business name on its single account.

## The clauses applied (hypothetical customers)

| Customer's existing host account | New host account requested | Opened? |
|---|---|---|
| None | Yes | Clause 1 permits the one account |
| Active, restricted, suspended or pending verification | Yes | No (Clause 2) |
| Deactivated by Roamhaven after a suspension | Yes | No (Clause 3) |

A deactivated account that was not deactivated by Roamhaven after a suspension is not covered by Clause 2 or Clause 3; those clauses state no further condition for it.

## Questions on the clauses

**How is a property-management business set up?** As one customer, with its business name on its single host account.

**Where do co-hosts and payout methods sit?** On the customer's one host account, together with every listing.
